Today's selection covers 82 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 54 on Artificial Intelligence and 18 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: State Attorneys General Are Investigating OpenAI
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Maine disables data breach notification portal after fake disclosures
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 19 articles published in the last 24 hours
